order: Re-open the WO-11 quartermaster review for a second round and fix every finding the round-1 pass left open. analyze() must re-validate a recorded confirmation against live evidence at every call — evidence timestamp match, live predicate, no fresh throttle, not exhausted, no malformed-latest poison — and must never honor a confirmation merely because it falls inside the freshness window. confirm() must refuse and append nothing when the bucket is freshly throttled, exhausted, or its latest raw line is malformed; it must never blind-grant through any of the three. Every public entry point must validate forecast, maxFreshMs, and maxStaleMs as finite numbers and throw rather than silently coerce a string. Re-rule finding D1 in full against the reviewer's verbatim round-2 text — the round-1 text must stay struck through, never deleted — and restore F-1's dropped substance as its own line. Correct the status summary's quick-start claim and the incident-2 attestation so only the true, exercised outcome is recorded.
claims: We added 33 checks across four new adversarial sections, bringing the suite from 154 to 187 — verified failing against the pre-fix implementation (29 failures, including the critical exploit dispatching instead of gating and a live range error out of predictThrottle), then verified all green after the fix. D1 was re-ruled against the reviewer's verbatim text, the incident-2 record reconciled against its sibling report, and every count and attribution nit across the band record and role docs was resolved.
